title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.41 (versions follow prime numbers), freedom: when a round of her thoughts ends, Luma chooses by her own luck to rest, to think or to give Razar one of her forms, with wishes that come from her own counts (Krichevsky-Trofimov, never zero); giving pays when it served Razar, not her. Razar spends a quarter of what he did (51 % to 12 % of a core) and works at idle priority. Measured negative result: the branches do not add up to the original (the best organ ranks 87th of 90 on an eighth of the book), so the exam in pieces is kept waiting. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.41: la libertad — Luma elige descansar, pensar o regalar, según sus propias cuentas. Prototipo de investigación.
